entities.summary: Carmelo Ferraro is an Italian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as the Archbishop of Agrigento for nearly two decades. He is particularly recognized for his role during the historic visit of Pope John Paul II to Sicily and his subsequent elevation as the first Metropolitan Archbishop of Agrigento.
